         4                  SENATOR WINNER:    Thank you, Madam

         5       President.  Just briefly on the resolution.

         6                  I'm proud to be able to wave the

         7       green flag, so to speak, as far as this

         8       resolution is concerned, New York State's

         9       celebration of NASCAR Day for 2006.

        10                  In my Senate district, Watkins Glen

        11       is the well-known home of the soul of American

        12       road racing, which over the course of over

        13       five decades has become a national

        14       institution, the premier road racing facility

        15       in America.

        16                  Watkins Glen is a source of pride

        17       for us and a source of pride for the State of

        18       New York and a landmark that attracts

        19       thousands of visitors every year and is, in

        20       fact, the largest sports attraction in

        21       New York State on an annual basis.

        22                  This year Watkins Glen celebrates

        23       its 20th year as the NASCAR Nextel Cup of

        24       racing, and over the past decade we've had

        25       thousands upon thousands of NASCAR fans to


                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910

                                                        2375



         1       visit Watkins Glen and the community of

         2       Watkins Glen, and certainly we know its

         3       enthusiasm.

         4                  In recognizing NASCAR's spirit

         5       today, this resolution seeks to have New York

         6       State join many, many other states in

         7       proclaiming Friday, May 19th, as NASCAR Day

         8       2006.  NASCAR Day is the signature charitable

         9       event of the NASCAR Foundation and supports a

        10       wide range of worthy charitable initiatives.

        11       It's an opportunity for all of us to draw

        12       attention to NASCAR fans across New York and

        13       bring them to a worthwhile cause, and a worthy

        14       opportunity for all of them to express their

        15       sense of community.

        16                  Thank you, Madam President.
